published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: fillInEpochGaps() did not correctly calculate and request rewards from overflowPool, resulting in lost rewards for unprofitable epochs.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Remove the call to fillInEpochGaps(). Or, move the call to checkRewardUnderflow() to the beginning of each new epoch. Or, restrict calls to fillInEpochGaps() to administrators only.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: The location of the _fillInEpochGaps() call is incorrect.
